insurer_name: ICICI Lombard General Insurance Company Limited
sub_limits_waiting_notes: PED 48 months; specific disease 24-48 months as listed; first 30 days for non-accident illness.

inpatient_hospitalization.limit_text: Up to Sum Insured plus Cumulative Bonus
inpatient_hospitalization.notes: Room rent capped 2% SI/day (max Rs.5000); ICU 5% SI/day (max Rs.10,000)

domiciliary_treatment.notes: Standard IRDAI condition: patient not in a condition to be moved or hospital room unavailable

ayush_coverage.limit_text: Up to Sum Insured in AYUSH Hospital (in-patient)
ayush_coverage.notes: Ayurveda, Yoga, Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha, Homeopathy

newborn_coverage.notes: Not a base benefit under standard Arogya Sanjeevani

organ_donor_expenses.notes: Standard Arogya Sanjeevani — donor coverage subject to wording

critical_illness_cover.notes: Not part of base Arogya Sanjeevani benefits

restoration_benefit.notes: Sum insured not refilled; cumulative bonus only

room_rent_capping: 2% of Sum Insured per day, subject to maximum Rs.5,000
icu_capping: 5% of Sum Insured per day, subject to maximum Rs.10,000
copayment_trigger_notes: Standard Arogya Sanjeevani mandates 5% copay on all admissible claims

disease_wise_sub_limits.cataract: 25% of SI or Rs.40,000 per eye per policy year, whichever is lower
disease_wise_sub_limits.modern_treatments: 50% of SI for listed modern treatments (uterine artery embolization, balloon sinuplasty, deep brain stimulation, oral chemotherapy, immunotherapy, intra vitreal injections, robotic surgeries, stereotactic radio surgeries, bronchial thermoplasty, vaporisation of prostate, IONM, stem cell therapy)

worldwide_emergency_cover.notes: Standard Arogya Sanjeevani is India only

permanent_exclusions: Rest cure, rehabilitation and respite care (Excl05)
temporary_exclusions: 30-day initial waiting period for non-accident illness
24/48 month specific disease/procedure waiting (cataract, hernia, joint replacement etc.)
notable_exclusions_summary: Standard IRDAI Arogya Sanjeevani exclusions: maternity, infertility, cosmetic, refractive error, weight control, change of gender, obesity, hazardous sports, war/nuclear, unproven treatments. 5% mandatory copay on every claim. Room rent 2% SI/day, ICU 5% SI/day, cataract Rs.40,000 or 25% SI per eye, ambulance Rs.2,000 per hospitalisation.
claim_process_summary: Cashless via ICICI Lombard empanelled network; toll free 1800 2666; reimbursement claim with bills, discharge summary, KYC.
